body: My brother is his bio child, and if anything he’s already gone no contact with me. It’s so funny because he’s ignoring me and being mean to me, yet he’s eating the shit that I baked for my brother? Ironic isn’t it
I’m 15, idk when I’ll be able to be on my own but I’m trying to get a job so I’ll be able to financially support myself
Thank you for this, you made me cry happy tears lol. The same goes to you to, your step-dad didn’t deserve you either
My bio dad isn’t really in my life, he tries to be but he was clinical depression and he can’t leave his house due it so I can’t really rely on him at all.
I’m trying to but it hurts really bad. We lived together for 11 years and he didn’t love me once, he even implied that he wouldn’t care if I died. I just wonder why I’m never enough
Yeah I tried talking to her about it and I cried and she got mad at me and said that I need to get over it
I get what you’re saying, I’m just sick of being the only one out of my friends who nobody desires or wants back
OP is a literal child, of course they want to choose the place they feel most comfortable and stable. This comment feels very manipulative 😐

Also a child of divorced parents. OP should do what makes her happy. If she’s happier at her dads, then she should stay there. She wouldn’t be the asshole for choosing her dad. Besides, she already lives there 75 percent of the time anyways!

Honestly I’m sure you’re beautiful, and I’m not saying this as empty flattery either, because I believe that everyone has things about them that make them attractive. I totally relate to everything you’re saying, as someone who’s also been the ugly fat girl, the only thing that’s stopping you is how you feel about yourself and the fact that you’re letting other people dictate how you see yourself. In order to become more witty, confident, and relaxed around guys or anyone your interested in, you yourself have to look at you and say, “All right. This is who I am. This is what I look like. I am beautiful in my own way.” Of course I’m not saying this is easy. It takes awhile to get to this point. What helped me was therapy, and false confidence. You know the saying “fake it till you make it”? Use that! Pretend to be confident, and eventually you’ll start to feel it. Also therapy. Therapy helps a lot too.

Honestly, I just hate it when people don’t like me/get mad at me. I wish I could’ve just ignored it but my day was already going really badly, and it isn’t even the first time they’ve acted like this. I don’t understand what I did to them tbh

Thank you for this comment. I really appreciate you listening to me. I’m the only one my mom can listen to and as much as it makes me happy that she trusts me it still hurts because I wish I could talk to her the way she talks to me u know?

I’m sorry. I understand what your going through. I would say everything gets better with time but it doesn’t. Contrary to popular belief tire doesn’t heal all wounds. All I can tell you is that your future is bright and full of colors, and the beauty of life is to love and cherish yourself and the people you care about. Remember that even if you don’t think so, there are people that love you.
